subject: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@adaptisys.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract

Hi Eric / Marta,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Adaptisys is ready to move forward but their procurement team has flagged two constraints that are blocking final signature:

- They need invoices issued on a quarterly cadence (Aligns with their fiscal vendor schedule).
- They requested an initial Net-90 window for the first invoice to align with their cash conversion timing.

Per our standard playbook we try not to deviate from monthly invoices and Net-45 terms, but this is a strategic 4-quarter deal and the onboarding timeline is tight. I'm attaching: Adaptisys_SOW_v3.pdf and an initial invoice schedule (adaptisys_invoice_schedule.xlsx) that they proposed.

Ask: Can we get an expedited review and exec exception for the following proposal so we can keep the signature momentum?

Proposed exception:
- Quarterly invoicing (4 invoices/year).
- Payment terms: Net-90 for the first invoice only, then Net-45 thereafter; no pricing concessions beyond standard T&Cs.

If Finance/Legal prefers a different guardrail (e.g., escrow/milestone or a short-term credit hold), let me know and I can propose a compromise to Adaptisys. Deal details: DEAL-2026-3092.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Laura, can you validate credit/risk and indicate if Net-90 is acceptable conditionally?
2) Jonas / Marissa, does Sales approve a one-time billing cadence exception for this account?

I’m available for a quick sync today if needed.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Adaptisys_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW draft), adaptisys_invoice_schedule.xlsx (customer-proposed cadence)

From: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@adaptisys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract

Hi Priyom,

Appreciate the clear summary. Confirming Adaptisys' position: our procurement requires vendor invoices to align to quarter boundaries to reconcile with multiple finance systems. The ask for Net-90 is not ideal for us long-term, but it is a necessary bridge for our first payment run.

We can accept quarterly invoices if Redwood is willing to:
- Issue the first invoice on 2026-10-01 with Net-90 (payable 2027-01-30).
- Subsequent invoices on 2027-01-01, 2027-04-01, etc., with Net-45.

If Redwood needs alternative safeguards (partial upfront, milestone invoice, or a small processing fee), please propose. We prefer to avoid upfront pre-pay.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps move approvals along.

Thanks,
Eric
Head of Vendor Ops | Adaptisys Inc.
Eric.Zhou@adaptisys.com

--
Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Procurement Lead, Adaptisys

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@adaptisys.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract

Priyom —

Thanks for the heads up and for attaching the schedule. I reviewed Adaptisys’ proposed cadence and ran a quick credit check. A few notes from Finance:

- Credit: no current delinquencies; internal ODAR score is medium.
- Quarterly invoicing is operationally manageable, but Net-90 exposes a meaningful cash flow gap.
- We can consider a temporary exception with conditions.

Suggested guardrails for approval:
1) Approve quarterly invoices.
2) Net-90 only for the first invoice and only if customer signs a payment commitment addendum (one-page) acknowledging schedule and providing a direct ACH remit contact.
3) If first invoice is not paid within 30 days past due, billing places account on credit hold and we reserve the right to revert to monthly billing plus late fees (2% monthly).

If Sales is insistent on no contractual addendum, I’d alternatively propose a Net-60 first-invoice window instead of Net-90 to reduce exposure.

I’m attaching an internal invoice matrix and a draft addendum for legal to review (redwood-net-terms-draft.docx).

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-net-terms-draft.docx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@adaptisys.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-05T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract

Team — quick update and compromise option.

Laura's ask for an addendum is reasonable. To keep the customer moving and limit Redwood's exposure, Adaptisys has agreed in principle to the addendum but asked if we could soften the Net-90 ask. They prefer staying aligned with their fiscal run.

Proposed compromise for exec review:
- Quarterly invoicing as requested.
- Payment terms: Net-75 for first two invoices (first invoice due 2027-01-15), then Net-45 for all subsequent invoices.
- Include the one-page payment commitment addendum and required ACH details before the first invoice is issued.

I am requesting executive sign-off on the above compromise and any final comments on whether we should require a nominal processing fee (Laura suggested 2% if we want to offset cash risk). If Sales approves, I'll get Legal to issue the addendum and schedule signature.

Next steps:
- Jonas / Marissa: please confirm approval or counter by end of day.
- If approved, Laura will circulate the addendum and Finance will set billing terms.

Thanks — I’ll also prepare a 15-minute call with Adaptisys for tomorrow.

Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Adaptisys_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@adaptisys.com>, Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@adaptisys.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: alternate billing cadence for Adaptisys contract

Priyom —

Approved with conditions. We will accept the quarterly cadence with the temporary Net-75 for the first two invoices and Net-45 thereafter, subject to the following:

1) Legal to issue the one-page payment commitment addendum and include explicit ACH remit instructions prior to signature.
2) Finance to place a hold flag in the billing system if payment is >30 days past due on the first invoice; revert to monthly billing and assess 2% monthly late fee if delinquent.
3) No additional discount or price concession beyond existing negotiated rates — this exception is purely billing cadence/terms.

Laura/Marissa: please proceed to update the SOW/contract with the addendum and notify Billing to set the invoice schedule for Q4 start. Priyom: ensure Adaptisys returns the completed addendum before we push the first invoice live.

Jonas Weber
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
